title: Mai Tsaron Ƙofar Fitowar Rana
intro: A cikin Alƙur'ani, wasu rayuka sun ratsa duniya suna barin hanyoyin hikima da al'ajabi. Wani irin wannan mutum ya yi tafiya zuwa wurare mafi nisa na halitta - inda rana ke fitowa da faɗuwa, inda shinge ke hana rudani. An bai wa wannan bawan Allah mulki wanda babu wanda zai sake mallaka. Ta hanyar tafiye-tafiye guda uku daban-daban, manufar wannan mutum ta bayyana. Za ku iya gane wannan mai yawo mai tatsuniya daga cikin inuwar tarihi?
clues: Mai rahama ya ba ni iko in yi mulkin duniya ta hanyar da babu wanda ya taɓa cimmawa.
Na yi tafiya ta yamma har sai da na isa wurin da rana ke faɗuwa, na ga tana faɗuwa a cikin wani maɓuɓɓugar ruwa mai duhu, sai na ga mutane a wurin.
Na yi tafiya zuwa gabas har sai da na isa wurin da rana ke fitowa, na same ta tana fitowa a kan mutanen da ba mu samar musu da mafaka daga gare ta ba.
Na yi tafiya tsakanin waɗannan wurare biyu masu tsauri har sai da na isa wani kwari tsakanin duwatsu biyu, inda na sami mutanen da ba su iya fahimtar magana da kyau ba.
Na sami shinge biyu masu tauri na ƙarfe a kan dutsen, waɗanda suka kai dama da hagu, kuma a tsakaninsu akwai wata hanya mai kunkuntar. Waɗannan mutanen sun roƙe ni in karya shingen da ke hana rudani.
Na ɗauki kayana na ce: 'Idan katangar ta fashe, wannan zai zama rabuwa a tsakaninmu da wannan mutanen.' Kuma lokacin da aka ƙayyade ya yi, na kalli yadda aka karya katangar a ƙarshe.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
